prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic scene set in a sunlit desert landscape under a deep blue sky, with rugged, sandy mountains in the background. In the foreground, feature two young women standing side by side, both with medium-length dark hair and wearing identical white, ribbed shirts with black-striped collars, evoking a sense of symmetry and unity. Each woman wears oversized, bold white sunglasses, their expressions calm and confident, gazing slightly off into the distance. The lighting is natural and warm, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of their clothing and hair. The composition is tight, focusing on their upper bodies and faces, with a shallow depth of field that subtly blurs the background, drawing attention to the subjects. The overall style is modern and minimalist, with a muted, earthy color palette that contrasts the crisp white of their outfits against the rich tones of the desert and sky, evoking a sense of cool, effortless style and enigmatic presence.
